args.title: Send the first week for newly created weekly scheduled exports
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

When a weekly scheduled export is created, its next run time calculation currently schedules it for the next occurrence, which may be incorrectly interpreted or set relative to the current time rather than the intended schedule window, causing the first scheduled run to be skipped if created on the same day. Adjust the scheduler logic in `src/export/scheduler.ts` to correctly handle initial weekly schedule creation so the first week's export is sent.
